messages.subject: [Forensim-help] forensim Lktable
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I have installed the dependencies for forensim (tcltk2 and tkrplot), however, Tktable was not installed with these. When I try to install Tktable I get an error saying Tktable is not available for R-2.14 or R-2.13. I was wondering if you have any idea of the R version necessary to install Tktable?
Thanks
Chris Steele

messages.subject: [Forensim-help] forensim Lktable
messages.body_plain:
Hi Chris,
Tktable is usually included with the R distribution, so you don't need to
install it manually.
If you are using a Mac, you need to install the corresponding tools to
enable Tcl/Tk (used for the GUIs provided in Forensim) to run properly.
You can get these from http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/tools/.
Can you also make sure you are running R.2.15.1 with forensim 3.2?
Cheers,
Hinda
